answer: Copying the same citations across 150 aliases therefore forfeits the authoring cost 150 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the horizon index resolves every citation against the whisper checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the voyage audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1293 identities would post 3093 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
